title: Rankings
one_line: Podium, rank rows, pinned self row, reward bands. Ships honest, real players only once online play exists.

anatomy.spec: Top 3, 1st centred and raised, 2nd left, 3rd right, each on a plinth with its crown (existing crown_gold/silver/bronze art).
Rank rows 4-50 (bible 5.18): flag, avatar 36, name, NX tag on the right.
Pinned to the bottom of the list, self blue gradient, 'Climb 3 places to reach Top 10'.
Thin divider rows between bands: 'TOP 10 - 50 energy + rare pack' with item icons.

states: Not ranked yet (new player) - self row shows 'Play a match to enter the rankings'
motion: Rows stagger in, 30 ms per row.
Podium crowns bounce in on load.
data: Real player rankings, server-owned, ships with online play (T-D4).
deviations: HONESTY GATE, not a design deviation but a build gate: this screen must NEVER show invented players as if they were real. It cannot go live with fabricated leaderboard entries - that breaks the project's core honesty rule and is a store-review risk (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 9). Build the UI now; wire it to real data only after T-D4. Until then it should either stay unreachable or show an honest 'Rankings open once online play launches' state.
do_not: Do not populate this with fake players.
Do not show the energy column - energy is fuel, not a score.
Do not exceed the folder-tab and segment maximums.
acceptance: UI is fully built and captures well with placeholder/self-only data.
No fabricated players appear under any circumstance.
Self row always pins to the bottom.
steps: 2. Build the hub chassis, tabs, segmented control, podium, rows.
3. Build the self-row pin logic and the not-ranked-yet state.
4. Gate the screen so it never shows fabricated players (see deviations).
5. Capture populated (self-only/placeholder), not-ranked and loading. Postflight.
prompt:
Build the Ludo NX Rankings hub.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md section 6.4 and 5.18, UI_BIBLE/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 9, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

Build: nameplate RANKINGS, folder tabs WEEKLY / ALL TIME, segmented GLOBAL / COUNTRY / FRIENDS, a reset countdown, a podium for the top 3 using the existing crown art, rank rows 4-50, and the player's own row pinned to the bottom in the self blue gradient.

CRITICAL HONESTY GATE: this screen must never show invented players as if they were real - that breaks project law and risks a store rejection. Build the full UI now, but it only shows real data once online play ships (T-D4). Until then, gate it behind an honest message or keep it showing only the player's own row.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
